snippet.title: Official First Gameplay Trailer | Age After Age
snippet.description:
Age After Age first gameplay trailer.

Age After Age is a city builder simulator where you lead your island civilization through multiple cultural paths and alternative ages. Shape your people through unique historical evolutions, choose radical new futures, or find balance by progressing through the classic ages of the world.

Every decision shapes your civilization.
The future of your people is in your hands.

Wishlist Age After Age now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/432120/Age_After_Age/

Discover more:
https://ageafterage.com
